name: Talkover
tagline: Talk to your coding agent. Hear it answer.
summary: Hands-free, two-way voice for Claude Code on Windows. Speak into a coding session, hear the response, and interrupt playback when you need to.
contribution: The local speech pipeline, voice panel, agent integration, and interruption behavior.
state: Public open-source project. See the repository for platform requirements.
filmNote: The panel is drawn by the app's own code. Original score; no voiceover.
details: Stop playback and pick up the conversation.

name: Kpop Sing
tagline: Sing the words the way they sound.
summary: A karaoke app that makes K-pop lyrics singable without reading Korean. Timed lyrics, practice, and a party experience bring the phone and a shared display together.
contribution: The mobile and web experience, multilingual lyric workflows, recording, and native TV integration.
state: Internal TestFlight build. TV receiver setup and device validation are in progress.
filmNote: Landscape marketing film composed from existing generated performers, the real app catalog and an original local score. Performance footage is promotional, not a live karaoke or device test.
details: Timed, phonetic lyrics built for singing along.
Phone controls and a shared display experience.

name: Brainrot Brawl
tagline: A cast of characters. One chaotic arena.
summary: A mobile party brawler built in Unity. The portfolio footage shows existing bot matches in the Mad Balls arena.
contribution: Game and mobile development, arena interaction, character integration, and the build and content pipeline.
state: Development build. The footage shows bots, rather than a public multiplayer session.
filmNote: Existing bot gameplay in a development build. Two source-continuous character sequences, composed for landscape with an original local score.
details: A pipeline from character assets to animated players.
Unity game development and mobile builds.

name: Punchpad
tagline: Record the set. Find the next one.
summary: A recording and review workspace for stand-up. Keep sets, bits, versions, and recordings together, return to the exact passage, and plan the next performance.
contribution: The recording and review workflow, version and span playback, phone app, and assistant integration.
state: Internal TestFlight build. Device testing is ongoing.
filmNote: Launch film from the real app using a fictional demo workspace. Original score.
details: Sets and recordings in one phone workflow.
Return to a version or a precise recording span.
Organize bits and build the next set.

name: crewboard
tagline: See the work while it is happening.
summary: A live view of coding sessions, subagents, and shared tasks. See what is working, what is waiting, and where a human decision is needed.
contribution: The local dashboard, session monitoring, task details, and shared human and agent task list.
state: Public open-source implementation. No adoption or productivity metrics asserted.
filmNote: Editorial film captured from the real app.
details: Ongoing coding sessions and subagents in one view.
A task list shared by the person and their agents.
Keep the work that needs attention visible.

name: agent-brain
tagline: Pick up where the last session stopped.
summary: Shared continuity for coding agents. Handoffs cite the files and lines behind them, projects stay separate, and changed-source evidence can be checked when work resumes.
contribution: The shared memory system, continuity commands, source-linked handoffs, and reproducible real-CLI evaluation.
state: Public project. The evaluation PR is open: 12 synthetic CLI scenarios and 59 passing tests; these are contract checks, not production performance claims.
filmNote: Diagram film using the tool's real command output.
details: Shared handoffs for Claude Code and Codex.
Source files and line evidence attached to the work.
Reproducible CLI scenarios for continuity and isolation.

tagline: A creative studio, from first look to inquiry.
summary: A studio website with space galleries and a path from browsing the work to making an inquiry. Behind it, an owner workspace keeps customer conversations and follow-up organized.
contribution: The public website, galleries, inquiry intake, customer conversation flows, and owner workspace.

filmNote: The new local J Will Media website: portfolio, two studio galleries and inquiry form. Photography belongs to John and his studio. The public studio domain still shows the previous website.

An owner workspace for contacts, messages, and campaigns.

details: Practice organized around a specific job and room.

name: Mad Balls

contribution: Arena gameplay and its integration into the Brainrot Brawl suite.
state: A minigame inside Brainrot Brawl, not a separate released product.
filmNote: Existing bot gameplay: a continuous pickup-to-impact sequence and the recorded match result. Landscape composition and original local score; no game changes.

name: BuildWhatever
summary: An AI-native game editor built on a Godot fork, bringing AI-assisted creative workflows into the engine's editing environment.
contribution: AI integration and editor tooling in the Godot-based engine.
state: Historical AI-native Godot fork. The public repository is no longer maintained. The film presents source architecture; an editor runtime recording has not been verified.
filmNote: Historical public-source study. Architecture maps of editor chat, scene context and the event bridge, drawn from pinned public C++ headers.
details: Public source archive and release repository.

name: 3D asset pipeline
summary: Tooling for the work between asset generation and a usable game character: import cleanup, humanoid setup, animation, texture compression, and performance.
contribution: Character import and preparation workflows for game development.
state: The film demonstrates material repair and inspection on an original game prop.
filmNote: Original and repaired material compared in Blender, followed by a turntable of the original repaired asset. Original local score.
